title: app-shell: MetadataService.retiredObjectEnabled corpus guard expects 47 ObjectSchema keys, main now has 48 after #26005 added sharing, so Test UI is red for every ui PR
body:
Filing gate ①: a red gate on `main`, measured. ⛔ Not a claim.

Since #26005 (5e113b39) `ObjectSchema` carries one more top-level key, `sharing` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`). `ui/packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.retiredObjectEnabled.test.ts:161` pins the key count as a corpus guard, `expect(accept.size).toBe(47)`, so it now fails with `expected 48 to be 47`. That makes `Test UI` red on every PR's merge ref. The first measured case is #26213, check-run 121679452481 (Test UI 8/16), on a diff that touches only marketplace files. Every ui PR in the merge queue will be ejected on it.

**Business reason.** The ui merge queue stalls. Every ui card's landing waits on a gate that has nothing to do with it.

**Fix.** Re-point the guard to 48, the same way the file has re-pointed it five times before. That means a comment line naming the adopted key (`sharing`, objectstack#26005), measured as exactly one key gained and none lost. The membership assertions below it stay as they are. Test-only, one file. No product change, and no sdui record moves (app-shell is outside the registry closure).

**Why the gate didn't catch it on #26005.** #26005 changed `packages/spec`, and its CI did not run this ui suite. That points at the turbo/CI filter gap #26092 is closing (root `turbo.json` and `ci.yml` core filter lines). That work is not part of this card.

**Who acts.** The `domain:ui` seat 2 dispatches it at once.

**Duplicate check.** I scanned the 40 newest issues and 30 newest PRs for `retiredObjectEnabled`, the guard count, and `48`. There were 0 relevant hits.
